messages.subject: Sangeeta | Mining, Metals & Energy Executive Profile | Government Relations, ESG & Country Leadership
messages.body:
Dear Ms. Lal,

I am sharing my profile for senior international leadership mandates across mining, metals, energy and clean technology.

I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My portfolio covers government and regulatory relations, ESG and social performance, corporate and external affairs, stakeholder strategy, strategic partnerships, compliance coordination and executive communications for a major gold-mining operation.

My current exposure also includes a large renewable-energy platform supporting mining operations, with approximately 46-50 MWp of solar and more than 80 MWh of battery storage.

Your TRANSEARCH specialization across mining, metals, energy and renewable energy, together with prior Middle East executive-search experience, aligns closely with the mandates I am pursuing. I am targeting Director, Senior Director, Head, Country Director and VP-track roles spanning External Affairs, Government Relations, Corporate Affairs, ESG, Sustainability, Strategic Partnerships, Social Performance and Country Leadership.

I have attached a tailored executive CV for confidential consideration. I am internationally mobile and available on 30 days' notice. Saudi Arabia and the UAE are priority GCC markets, while I remain open to strong global mandates.

Kind regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department | AGM Inc.
